unit.why: Collection of homiletic and kabbalistic teachings by R. Alexander Sender of Komarno: exegesis of verses, Zohar, the Sabbath, and the Etz Hayyim, plus a moral rebuke about using gentile courts; there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: continues the section on R. Alexander Sender begun in previous division; ends with heading of next section (מערכת ה)
